   def repair_vector(h, N):
       s = np.sum(h)
       if abs(s - N/2) > 1e-1:

           # Scale to nearest integrable fraction
           target = N/2
           current_sum = s = np.sum(h)

           h_adjusted /= (np.sum(h_adjusted)/target)

   def bayesian_objective(h):
       corr = np.correlate(h, 1-h, mode='full')
       return (np.max(corr) * (2.0/len(h)))
